title: Part V · Section 07
subtitle: Forms
introEn: Read the passage and choose the best answer.

items.prompt: Where would you most likely find this application form?
items.passage: Questions 1-2 refer to the following form. BEST FITNESS Please fill out the registration form below. Name Age Weight Height Home Address Telephone No. Medical History Note: All members will have to undergo a 30-minute medical examination and a one-hour introduction training session with a member of our staff. These procedures will be repeated annually for your health and safety.

choices.D: Once a year Questions 3-4 refer to the following form. TUNNEL NOTICE As a result of increased maintenance costs, we regret to announce the following price increases. Please see below: Old Price New Price Motorbike ― Car $1 $1.50 Car & Trailer $1.50 $2 Minivan $4 $4 Commercial bus $5 $7.50 Truck $10 $15 Prices will come into effect as of November 2009.

items.prompt: How often do people have to attend the introduction training session?

choices.A: To inform people of maintenance work in November
choices.B: To inform people of possible delays in the tunnel
choices.C: To inform people of the new costs of using the tunnel
choices.D: To inform people what vehicles are allowed to use the tunnel
